findings.evidence: Mathlib/GroupTheory/QuotientGroup/Basic.lean:85-90 defines `prodMulEquiv`/`prodAddEquiv` over `Subgroup.prod` quotients; Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Quotient/Defs.lean:61-68 shows `Submodule.Quotient.mk := Quotient.mk''`. `Submodule.liftQ_apply` exists and is used as a `simp` lemma (Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/TensorProduct/RightExactness.lean:278). The deleted proof is in the PR diff for TauCeti/Analysis/Fredholm/Prod.lean.
findings.fix: Keep the deleted construction: `LinearEquiv.ofBijective ((p.prod q).liftQ (p.mkQ.prodMap q.mkQ) hker.ge) ⟨…⟩`. Then `quotientProdEquiv_apply_mk` follows from `Submodule.liftQ_apply`/`Submodule.mkQ_apply`/`LinearMap.prodMap_apply` (all `simp` lemmas), and `quotientProdEquiv_symm_apply_mk` from `LinearEquiv.symm_apply_eq` plus that lemma — no cross-wrapper defeq anywhere.
findings.issue: `quotientProdEquiv` is `AddEquiv.toLinearEquiv (QuotientAddGroup.prodAddEquiv p.toAddSubgroup q.toAddSubgroup)`, whose type is `((M × N) ⧸ p.toAddSubgroup.prod q.toAddSubgroup) ≃+ …`; it unifies with the declared `((M × N) ⧸ p.prod q) ≃ₗ[R] (M ⧸ p) × (N ⧸ q)` only by unfolding both quotient wrappers and their inferred `AddCommGroup` instances. The `map_smul'` obligation (line 45, `rintro r ⟨x⟩; rfl`) and both computation lemmas (lines 61-65, `convert … using 1 <;> rfl` through `Quotient.mk''`) are undocumented defeq steps across that boundary — the comment at 47-51 states outright that the structures 'are not interchangeable at rewrite transparency'. The version deleted from `Analysis/Fredholm/Prod.lean` needed none of this.

findings.evidence: Lines 59-65: the proof is `constructor` followed by two unrelated `convert` calls; lines 71 and 78 consume it as `(… ).1 x` and `(… ).2 x y`.
findings.fix: Drop the bundle (moot under the fix above); if some bridge is still wanted, state it as two ordinary named lemmas.
findings.issue: `quotientProdEquiv_mk_bridge` bundles two logically independent statements into an `And` to 'isolate' the defeq conversion, but the two halves share no reasoning — they are two separate `convert … <;> rfl` proofs in one declaration — and the public `@[simp]` lemmas then have to project through `.1`/`.2`.

findings.evidence: Lines 34-35 declare the same variables for the whole `section Quotient`; Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Dimension/Constructions.lean:143,161 shows `Module.finrank_prod` needs exactly `StrongRankCondition`, `Module.Free`, `Module.Finite`.
findings.fix: Delete the duplicated binder block; keep only `[StrongRankCondition R]` and the `Module.Free`/`Module.Finite` instances, which are the ones `Module.finrank_prod` actually adds.
findings.issue: `finrank_quotient_prod` re-declares `{R M N : Type*} [Ring R] [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R M] [Module R N]`, shadowing the identical section binders at lines 34-35.

summary: The relocated `quotientProdEquiv` replaces a self-contained `Submodule.liftQ`/`ofBijective` construction with one that type-checks only through the definitional identification of `Submodule.Quotient` with `QuotientAddGroup`, forcing a `convert … <;> rfl` bridge for every downstream fact. Rebuild it inside the `Submodule` API.
